description.zh: 数据库分类命名空间，默认填写主账号Uid
description.en: The namespace for database categorization. By default, this is the UID of the Alibaba Cloud account.

description.zh: 数据库名称匹配的正则表达式，全部匹配则传入.*
description.en: A regular expression that matches database names. To match all databases, enter .\*.

description.zh: 翻页token，由结果返回，如第一页可传入""
description.en: The token to retrieve the next page of results. This is returned in the response. For the first page, pass an empty string ("").
The number of entries to return on each page.
